summary: Fresh latest-HEAD A continuation consumed the C127/Q00025-released odd index99 preflight. The exact canonical pinned 4F68708E DXT5 source fingerprint is reused. The C127-accepted threshold-18 full-effect rule is materialized losslessly as 42,774 removal pixels plus the exact protected-panel complement. A deterministic native-resolution clean-plate reconstruction patch is embedded in this durable task record: decoded RGBA outside the removal mask is unchanged (0 pixels, 0 alpha changes) and the reconstructed mask contains 0 alpha-positive pixels at luminance >=18. No pre-existing C-accepted KOREAN_RENDER_NEXT/RENDER_READY handoff existed for index99. This task does not claim the clean plate visually accepted: C native visual review, signed source-style lock, Hangul lettering render, and DXT5/BC3 round-trip remain before candidate DDS. Current GitHub v2 builder blob explicitly fails closed on compressed DDS and only writes exact-header uncompressed BGRA, so no speculative BC3 candidate is emitted. No shared state, peer lane, runtime, build, N100, Drive, local clone, Library, VR/FFB/DX changes.

removal_mask.rule: alpha>0 AND Rec601_luminance>=18 within exact panel ROI

protected_panel_mask.rule: exact panel ROI complement of removal_mask

clean_plate.patch_pixel_order: scanline order over removal_mask RLE runs
